name: PlanarReflection
src_typeComment: Real planar reflections for a flat water surface (mirrors, wet floors) — a second camera renders the scene MIRRORED across this object's own plane (transform.position/up) into a low-res RenderTexture, which the water shader then samples via screen-space UV (see PlanarReflectionInclude.cginc). This is the classic Built-in RP technique (the same one Unity's old "Water" Standard Asset used): compose the main camera's view matrix with a reflection matrix rather than deriving position/rotation separately, and use an OBLIQUE near-clip plane so geometry behind the water surface never appears in its own reflection.  Deliberately NOT GrabPass — this renders its OWN small, controlled RenderTexture once per frame (see [[unitytools-toolkit-conventions]] / the GrabPass explanation this was built alongside), not a full- screen copy for every reflective object.

src_serialized.name: reflectionMask
src_serialized.tooltip: What gets rendered INTO the reflection. Exclude UI, water itself, and anything expensive that wouldn't be missed at a glance.

src_serialized.name: textureSize
src_serialized.tooltip: Resolution of the reflection RenderTexture — the actual cost lever. Low is fine; a blurry/soft reflection reads as realistic anyway (real water is rarely a perfect mirror).

src_serialized.name: clipPlaneOffset
src_serialized.tooltip: Pushes the clip plane very slightly along the surface normal, avoiding a thin sliver of self-intersection artifacts right at the water line.

src_serialized.name: updateEveryNFrames
src_serialized.tooltip: Re-renders the reflection every N frames instead of every frame — 1 = every frame (smoothest, priciest), higher trades smoothness for cost. Water rarely needs a perfectly current reflection.

src_serialized.name: disablePixelLightsWhileRendering
src_serialized.tooltip: Temporarily drops the quality-settings pixel light count to 0 while rendering the reflection — a real, well-established cost cut for a scene reflection that doesn't need per-pixel lighting fidelity.

src_members.sig: public static Vector4 PlaneEquation(Vector3 position, Vector3 normal, float sideSign, float offset)
src_members.name: PlaneEquation
src_members.comment: A plane through `position` with unit `normal`, expressed as (a, b, c, d) for ax+by+cz+d=0, nudged slightly along the normal by `offset` and flipped by `sideSign` (matches CameraSpacePlane's signature so both can build a consistent plane representation).

src_members.sig: public static Vector4 CameraSpacePlane(Camera camera, Vector3 position, Vector3 normal, float sideSign, float offset)
src_members.name: CameraSpacePlane
src_members.comment: The same plane, but expressed in `camera`'s own view space — what Camera.CalculateObliqueMatrix needs to clip a projection to exactly that plane.

src_members.name: CalculateReflectionMatrix
src_members.comment: The 4x4 matrix that reflects any world-space point/vector across the given plane. Composed with a camera's own worldToCameraMatrix (reflectionCamera.worldToCameraMatrix = source.worldToCameraMatrix * this), it turns that camera's view into the mirrored view a reflection needs — standard Householder reflection extended to a general plane via the plane's own (a,b,c,d) equation.
